title: •We’re The Bait
caption: •We’re The Bait (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. It’s A Trap! may not be played. Once per game, may use 1 Force to ▼ an Effect with “Bespin” or “Cloud City” in lore or game text. If Chewie, Han, Leia, or Luke wins a battle on Cloud City, place this Effect in Used Pile.
lore: “He doesn’t want you at all, he’s after somebody called, uh... Skywalker.” “Luke?” “Lord Vader has set a trap for him.” “And we’re the bait!” “Yeah, well, he’s on his way.”

notes: Unique. Curly apostrophe in the slip's heading and caption (We’re); wiki page title uses a straight one. Printed base is a Utinni Effect; slip banner reads EFFECT, no grabber box, no immunity icon. The slip prints ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Curly apostrophe in It’s; curly double quotes around “Bespin” and “Cloud City”. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes around each quoted line and curly apostrophes in doesn’t / he’s / we’re / he’s (wiki straight single quotes); the scan prints a space after the ellipsis ('uh... Skywalker', wiki 'uh...Skywalker'), ellipsis printed as three spaced dots. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Cloud City) not legible. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2-D-werethebait-pre.gif, 350 px; non-pre also exists).
